checkRuns.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/components/contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    if (error instanceof ActionError && error.data?.errors)
      errors.set(error.data.errors)
    else
      throw error""","""    if (!(error instanceof ActionError))
      throw error

    errors.set((error.data as { errors?: ContactErrors } | undefined)?.errors ?? {})""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -20

cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { Elysia } from 'elysia'
import { pages } from 'kay/server'

// Exported for `kay check`, which checks links against the routes it serves besides the pages and types `ctx.locals` from its plugins.
export const app = new Elysia().use(await pages()).listen({
  port: Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000),
  hostname: process.env.HOST ?? '0.0.0.0',
})

console.log(`Listening on http://localhost:${app.server?.port}`)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; cat /tmp/kay-server.log
for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /about /contact /nope /books/nope; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:4701$p; sed -e 's/<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\/script>//g' /tmp/out.html | grep -o '<body.*' | head -c 2500; echo; done
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3; pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa "src/server.ts" || echo "server stopped"; git status --short
